concept.material: gunmetal bronze and oxidized verdigris brass with mother-of-pearl inlays
concept.internal_detail: blued steel drive chains, miniature rack-and-pinion linkages, and articulated brass rib armatures
concept.button: a flush lapis lazuli button set into the dorsal ridge
concept.button_short: the flush lapis lazuli button along the dorsal ridge

concept.signature_move: its segmented caudal fin sways twice from side to side on a miniature ball joint while its twin ventral paddle fins pivot back and forth in opposing rhythms
concept.turkish: Selakant (antik, loblu yüzgeçli derin deniz balığı) — oluklu kayık biçimli kabuk, namlu metali bronz ve yeşil paslı pirinç

concept.button_short: the circular mother-of-pearl push stud on the upper dorsal ridge
